item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 30/Aug/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will strengthen gradually in the next couple of days, and bring mainly fine weather to southeastern China. Meanwhile, under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure, there will be a few showers over the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China. Winds will be weak over Guangdong early next week. The weather will be very hot, high temperatures will also trigger showers. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the western North Pacific to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea in the middle and latter parts of next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Shanshan will move towards the vicinity of Shikoku of Japan today, and then linger over the region.
